# shenron
> Platform behind dragonballfr.com: Next.js site, Bun HTTP API server, Discord bot, manga translation studio, databook pipeline. Bun (pinned by package.json#packageManager) and TypeScript 7; the Rust workspace lives in aphrody-labs/wiki.

This file describes the repository. The `/llms.txt` served by the site is generated by `apps/site/src/app/llms.txt/route.ts`.

## Entry points
- Agent contract: AGENTS.md
- Layout and gates per area: MAP.tsv
- Health: /api/health
